request.free_text: The compressor is very loud. Can I put some oil on it to quiet it down while it runs?

rule_hits.message: Never use oil, grease or any petroleum product on or near the oxygen path. Oxygen-enriched environments turn lubricants into a fire hazard.
rule_hits.citation: WHO Technical specifications for oxygen concentrators (2015), safety section; manufacturer service manuals, warnings page
